note: Checked 14 November 2026. All times are GMT. Still to confirm: Northern Lights nightly entry times (published only as an image) and peak prices, and the diversion routes for Corporation Street, Bury Old Road and Crumpsall Way, which TfGM doesn't publish. TfGM doesn't say which direction of Corporation Street is closed; the stops it marks as not served are on the into-town side. The MoRun at Heaton Park (Sun 22 Nov) is left out because its entry page blocked fetching. Kick-offs can move for TV.

cards.headline: SAT–SUN TO 20 DEC
cards.title: Corporation Street shut one way at weekends
cards.body: Corporation Street is closed in one direction between Miller Street and Todd Street from 08:00 on Saturday to 21:00 on Sunday every weekend until Sunday 20 December. The 135, 41, 59, 97, 98, 99 and other routes divert. Heading into town, the 135 and 41 don't call at the Victoria Rail Station, Printworks or High Street / Turner Street stops.
cards.mg_alt: Route diagram of the 135 and 41 into town at weekends: the Victoria Rail Station, Printworks, Turner Street and Church Street stops are not served.

cards.title: Bury Old Road shut overnight to 23 Nov
cards.body: Bury Old Road now closes overnight only, from 20:00 to 06:00 every night until Monday 23 November. At those times the 135 and 97 divert, and the 135 doesn't call at stops from St Monica's High School and Heaton Park tram stop to Walker Avenue in Kirkhams. TfGM lists no changes to Bury line trams this week.
cards.mg_alt: Route diagram of the 135 on Bury Old Road: from 20:00 to 06:00 the stops from St Monica's through Heaton Park tram stop to Walker Avenue are not served.

cards.title: Hospital buses divert at weekends to 29 Nov
cards.body: Crumpsall Way inside North Manchester General Hospital closes from 07:00 on Saturday to 15:30 on Sunday each weekend until Sunday 29 November, so the 41, 52, 53, 94, 151 and other routes divert and miss some hospital stops. Crescent Road stays closed until 31 March 2027, keeping the same routes away from the Abraham Moss Centre stops.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Sunday 15, Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November marked for the hospital road closure, over a bar for the Crescent Road closure running to March 2027.

cards.title: M60 J18 link to the M66 shut overnight
cards.body: The free-flow link from the M60 clockwise at junction 18 to the M66 northbound is closed from 21:00 to 06:00 every night from Monday 16 to Friday 20 November. National Highways publishes a diversion map and says closures can change at short notice. A 50mph limit stays in place through the Simister Island works.
cards.what: Clockwise link to M66 N shut
cards.mg_alt: Motorway diagram: the M60 clockwise free-flow link at junction 18 to the M66 northbound closed overnight Monday to Friday.

cards.title: Deansgate station shuts on market evenings
cards.body: Deansgate rail station closes from 20:00 on Fridays and 18:00 on Saturdays while the Christmas Markets run, until 22 December. Use Piccadilly, Oxford Road or Victoria instead. On Sunday 22 November, buses replace trains between Blackburn and Clitheroe, Colne and Burnley Manchester Road, which affects Victoria to Clitheroe trains.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Friday 20 November marked 20:00 and Saturday 21 marked 18:00 for the Deansgate station closures, and Sunday 22 marked for Clitheroe line replacement buses.

cards.title: City host Fulham on a busy arena weekend
cards.body: City host Fulham at the Etihad at 12:30 on Saturday 21 November, and Co-op Live has Hits Radio Live the same day. Both arenas have events on Sunday 15, Thursday, Friday and Saturday, plus Tuesday at the AO Arena and Sunday 22 at Co-op Live. Alan Turing Way is still shut northbound by the Etihad, and TfGM expects delays.

span.label: Alan Turing Way northbound shut since 4 Apr

cards.mg_alt: Week strip with arena events marked on Sunday 15, Tuesday 17, Thursday 19, Friday 20 and Sunday 22 November, and City v Fulham plus two arena events on Saturday 21, over a bar for the Alan Turing Way closure.

cards.title: More Sunday trains to Victoria from 22 Nov
cards.body: From Sunday 22 November, Northern adds 14 Sunday trains between Bolton and Manchester Victoria, 10 between Rochdale and Victoria, and 10 between Wigan North Western and Victoria via Atherton. Some extra trains will also run between Manchester Piccadilly and Hazel Grove. More Sunday trains between Clitheroe and Victoria follow from 13 December.
cards.mg_alt: Dot-matrix readout of 34, the number of extra Sunday trains to Manchester Victoria from 22 November.

cards.title: Amazon's Black Friday Week starts Thursday
cards.body: Amazon UK's Black Friday Week runs from Thursday 19 to Monday 30 November, taking in Black Friday on 27 November and Cyber Monday on 30 November. You don't need Prime to shop the sale, but some daily deals are for Prime members only.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Thursday 19 November marked as the start of Amazon's Black Friday Week, with a bar running past the week to 30 November.

cards.title: Northern Lights trail opens at Heaton Park
cards.body: The Northern Lights trail opens at Heaton Park on Thursday 19 November and runs to Thursday 31 December, with a new Christmas Time Machine theme. Entry is timed, with off-peak tickets from £15.25. Car parking costs £7.50 and must be booked ahead. By tram or 135, use Gate 13 opposite Heaton Park tram stop; after 20:00 the 135 doesn't stop there.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Thursday 19 November marked as opening night and a bar running past the week to 31 December.

cards.title: Rayzl sings the archive at the Jewish Museum
cards.body: Rayzl: Singing the Archive is a recital with a Q&A in the synagogue at Manchester Jewish Museum, 190 Cheetham Hill Road, on Thursday 19 November from 19:00 to 20:15. Doors and the café open at 18:00. Tickets are £12, or £10 for members and under-30s, and it's for ages 12 and over. Museum entry is free for M8 residents who sign up.
cards.mg_alt: Time axis from 17:00 to 21:00 with the 19:00 to 20:15 recital highlighted.

cards.title: Johnny Campbell at Crumpsall Folk Club
cards.body: Sheffield singer Johnny Campbell headlines Crumpsall Folk Club at The Cleveland on Crumpsall Lane, opposite Crumpsall tram stop, on Thursday 19 November. Doors open at 19:30, floor spots start at 19:45 and the main act is on around 21:00. Entry is £5, £2 concessions or £10 solidarity, with proceeds to Rainbow Surprise.
cards.mg_alt: Dot-matrix readout of £5, the entry price, for Thursday 19 November with doors at 19:30.
